title: RhoFold+ — RNA 3D structure prediction
description: Predict a 3D structure for an RNA sequence with RhoFold+, a language-model-based deep learning method, and return the predicted coordinates (PDB) plus per-residue pLDDT confidence. v1 runs in single-sequence mode (no MSA).
citation: Shen et al., Accurate RNA 3D structure prediction using a language model-based deep learning approach. Nature Methods (2024). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02487-0 — code https://github.com/ml4bio/RhoFold (Apache-2.0).

fields.name: sequence
fields.label: RNA sequence
fields.help: A single RNA sequence over A/C/G/U (N allowed for unknown positions). Predicted in single-sequence mode — no MSA.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.help: Recorded for provenance; RhoFold's prediction is deterministic for a given input.

example_summary: A 14-nucleotide UUCG-tetraloop hairpin (GGCACUUCGGUGCC), bundled so you can try the sequence -> 3D-structure path without supplying your own.
example_details: A well-characterised minimal RNA hairpin: a 5-bp stem (GGCAC/GUGCC) closing the ultra-stable UUCG tetraloop. It exercises the sequence -> PDB + pLDDT path end to end and folds without an MSA. Swap in any single RNA sequence over A/C/G/U. Real inference returns RhoFold's predicted coordinates (per-residue pLDDT in the B-factor column); the stub/fake backend returns a deterministic placeholder PDB (engine=stub).
notes: v1 is single-sequence mode (--single_seq_pred True): no MSA generation at runtime, which would need network + databases and break job isolation. MSA-as-optional-upload is deferred (needs a new a3m field type). The checkpoint (rhofold_pretrained_params.pt, cuhkaih/rhofold on Hugging Face) must be pre-baked + checksummed into the worker image — RhoFold auto-downloads it otherwise, which violates the immutable-image / no-runtime-network rule. source_commit, checkpoint_digest, worker_image_digest, max_length and job_timeout_s stay provisional until confirmed by a Runpod smoke run; RhoFold is heavy, so watch cold-start + runtime against the dev budget. Verify the checkpoint's redistribution terms (code is Apache-2.0; weights license is separate) before publishing any image. The runner reports engine=rhofold vs engine=stub.
